title: AdaptServe: Auto-Scalable DL Serving with Dynamic Model Parallelism
selection_reason: AdaptServe is a DL serving system combining ILP-based parallel replica placement with deep-RL runtime replica management under dynamic model parallelism, targeting throughput, scalability and latency for online inference.
venue: International Conference on High Performance Scientific Computing
